# Shivaay Logistics

> Shivaay Logistics is a customs broker and logistics facilitator based in Ludhiana, Punjab, India, with 15+ years of experience and 800+ clients. It provides customs clearance, freight forwarding (air, sea, road, rail), warehousing and import-export documentation across India, with operations in Ludhiana, Amritsar, Delhi, Mumbai and Mundra.

Canonical site: https://www.shivaaylogistics.in

## Business details

- Name: Shivaay Logistics
- Type: Customs broker & logistics facilitator
- Headquarters: Plot No. 116, Street No. 8, Ganesh Nagar, 33 Feet Road, Near Ashiana Enclave, Mundian Kalan, Ludhiana-141015, Punjab, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 88474-67790
- Email: shivaaylogistics2022@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM IST; Sunday closed
- Service locations: Ludhiana (headquarters), Amritsar (border hub), Delhi (distribution hub), Mumbai (major port), Mundra (port hub)

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.shivaaylogistics.in/): Company overview, core services, coverage map and client testimonials
- [Services](https://www.shivaaylogistics.in/services): Customs clearance, air/sea/road/rail freight, door-to-door delivery, project cargo, warehousing, cargo insurance, packaging, documentation, LCL consolidation and 3PL
- [Contact](https://www.shivaaylogistics.in/contact): Phone, email, office address, map and enquiry form

## Resources for importers and exporters

- [Resources overview](https://www.shivaaylogistics.in/resources): Hub for the pages below
- [Quick links](https://www.shivaaylogistics.in/resources/links): ICEGATE, DGFT, customs duty calculator, exchange rates and shipping bill enquiry
- [Documents required](https://www.shivaaylogistics.in/resources/documents): Checklists for AD Code registration, IEC application, Bill of Entry, Shipping Bill, GST refunds, LUT and customs clearance
- [Download files](https://www.shivaaylogistics.in/resources/files): Customs circulars, declarations, RODTEP schedules and blank forms
- [Ports, ICDs and CFS in Ludhiana](https://www.shivaaylogistics.in/resources/ports): Clearance points including CONCOR, Gateway Distriparks, Pristine, Hind Terminals, Adani and PLIL
